item.text:
The F27 stall is now root-caused at the recovery state level.

In seed 3 under the F6/F12/F17/F27 stack, recoverer 1 ends with `tpaReps=2`, `preAcceptOKs=0`, `nacks=2`, `lastTriedBallot=6`, and all five replicas still PREACCEPTED. TryPreAccept replies carry peers’ old value ballot and are counted as nacks; their `ConflictStatus=PREACCEPTED` is below ACCEPTED, so the abandon-to-phase-1 path does **not** fire, and the queue empties with no further progress ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix17_seed3_debug_output.txt)).

That explains why merely guessing the sub-case 4 threshold is insufficient: the reply ballot/conflict-status handling must also be reconciled with the intended recovery flow. F27 remains an unresolved Medium defect with a negative diagnostic, not a recommended fix.

The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; captured source is unchanged and builds. The new state trace is recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md), [validation_matrix.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), [remediation.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/remediation.md), and [handoff_check.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/handoff_check.txt).
